description:
Device configuration states for this device.

TIP: Lists configuration profile states for a specific managed device. Shows which configuration profiles apply and their state (notApplicable, success, error, conflict). Each has displayName, state, settingCount.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.

name: list-device-configuration-states
